key_points.evidence_quote: On this episode of modernizing the situation, Katherine Boyle and I are joined by A16Z General Partner Mark Andreessen to talk about the films that capture the country's turning points, from Hollywood's golden age to the counter-culture, from the comedies we could once make to the stories that still define us.
